categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of adsorption separation materials and integrated system devices based on adsorption separation technology. Its main product lines include adsorption separation materials such as ion exchange resins, chelating resins, uniform particle resins, solid-phase synthesis carriers, chromatographic fillers, and biological separation media. The company serves multiple sectors including metal resources, life sciences, water treatment and ultrapure water, food processing, energy conservation and environmental protection, and chemical catalysis. Additionally, it provides integrated system solutions combining materials, processes, and equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes proprietary technologies including spray granulation for uniform particle resin synthesis, functional group grafting, and continuous adsorption processes. It has developed advanced materials such as chelating resins for metal extraction, solid-phase synthesis carriers for peptides and nucleic acids, and enzyme carriers for industrial bioprocesses. The production methods emphasize high precision, selectivity, and environmental friendliness, with automated and controlled manufacturing processes. The company also integrates system engineering capabilities to deliver customized adsorption separation solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span industries such as metal extraction and refining (including lithium, gallium, cobalt, nickel), biopharmaceuticals (vaccines, antibodies, peptides), water treatment (drinking water, ultrapure water for electronics and nuclear power), food processing (juice concentration, sweetener extraction), environmental protection (VOC treatment, heavy metal wastewater), and chemical catalysis. The company serves both domestic and international markets, including North America, Europe, Asia, South America, and Africa, with a strong presence in emerging sectors like new energy and life sciences.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Xi'an and multiple production bases including high-tech industrial parks and subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Germany, Belgium, Ireland, Argentina, and the United States. Its international subsidiaries and sales networks cover major global markets such as North America, Europe, South America, Asia, and Africa. The company has established overseas marketing and technical service centers to support global operations and enhance local responsiveness.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily upstream and midstream in the supply chain, focusing on the development and manufacturing of specialized adsorption separation materials and related system devices. It supplies these materials and integrated solutions to downstream industries such as metal refining, pharmaceuticals, water treatment, and chemical processing. The company also provides technical services and system integration, positioning itself as a comprehensive technology and materials provider within the adsorption separation industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in adsorption separation materials, expanding applications in emerging fields such as lithium extraction, biopharmaceutical purification, and environmental protection. The company emphasizes R&D in material synthesis, functionalization, and system integration, supported by a large R&D team and collaborations with universities. It focuses on industrializing new technologies, enhancing product quality, and developing integrated solutions to meet evolving customer needs. Internationalization and digital management improvements are also key strategic directions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of adsorption separation materials and system integration devices. The company also earns income from technical services related to adsorption separation technology. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels, with a significant portion of revenue derived from domestic and international customers. The company’s revenue streams include product sales, system solution contracts, and associated technical support services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a domestic industry leader and internationally recognized enterprise in adsorption separation materials and technology. It holds a dominant market share in China, especially in lithium extraction and gallium recovery, and competes with multinational corporations in high-end applications. The company differentiates itself through its integrated 'materials + equipment' solution model and strong R&D capabilities. It is recognized as a national high-tech enterprise and manufacturing champion, with a robust competitive position in both traditional and emerging application sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.55 billion, representing a 2.62% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 787 million, up 9.79%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 6.09 billion, with net assets of RMB 3.91 billion, showing steady growth. Operating cash flow was healthy at RMB 731 million. The company has maintained a stable and growing business base, with expanding production capacity and increasing international sales, which grew by 45.12% in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary adsorption separation materials with precise selectivity and high performance, enabling efficient extraction, purification, and separation in complex environments. Its unique value lies in integrating advanced materials with customized system devices and application processes to provide flexible, one-stop solutions tailored to customer needs. The company’s technology leadership, broad product portfolio, and ability to industrialize innovative applications in strategic sectors such as new energy metals and biopharmaceuticals create a strong competitive moat. Its commitment to green, sustainable production and ESG principles further differentiates it in the market.
